description: North Carolina Arts Council — Sustaining Support for Arts Organizations (URL path, state arts council, operating support)

gold_labels.funding_amount: $7,500 to $65,000. Grant awards may not exceed 10% of the organization's cash operating expenses averaged over the past three fiscal years.
eligibility: Arts organization with 501(c)(3) status that has creation and/or promotion of arts in its mission and dedicates at least 80% of annual programming expenses to arts activities
Must meet NC Arts Council general eligibility criteria
Average organizational expense budget of at least $75,000 over past three fiscal years
Employ at least one half-time equivalent staff person (20 hours/week, minimum wage or above)
Colleges, universities, and arts organizations that are part of another entity (such as a municipality) are not eligible
Organizations receiving Statewide Service Organizations funding or county Grassroots allotment as Designated/Provisional County Partner are generally not eligible
FY2026-27 eligible disciplines: literature, visual arts, film, and dance
required_sections: Overview of programs and activities for proposed grant year
evaluation_criteria: Artistic value of an organization's programs
Involvement of artists and arts professionals who are qualified, paid equitably, and reflect demographic diversity
Programs with demonstrated benefit to audiences, participants, and broader community
Strength of audience engagement and outreach strategies
Evidence of staff and board leadership and sound management practices, including financial accountability
gold_labels.funder_overview: Provides flexible operating support funding to North Carolina arts organizations that consistently produce arts programs and services. Grants awarded on a three-year cycle by discipline with panel review. Supports salaries, artists' fees, production, travel, promotion, office expenses, and facility operation.
